verdict: Lumentum's revenue jumped 137% to $1.26B on AI data-center demand — and this time it dropped through to profit, with net income of $360M versus $4M a year ago.

segments.name: Components
segments.note: Lasers and other photonic building blocks sold into data-center and telecom gear — pump lasers were a leading growth contributor this quarter. Revenue nearly doubled year over year.

segments.name: Systems
segments.note: Finished optical systems, including optical circuit switches (OCS) for AI data centers. Revenue more than tripled as OCS demand visibility expanded sharply.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Developing next-generation lasers, modules and switches — more than double a year ago as Lumentum invests behind AI demand.

opex.name: SG&A
opex.note: Selling, general and administrative — selling the products and running the company.

opex.name: Gain on sale of business, net
opex.note: A credit: Lumentum sold a business for more than its book value, so this line reduces expenses.

costNote: Making the lasers and systems ($600M of cost of sales) plus $19M of amortization on acquired technology — together $618M after whole-million rounding.
otherDetail: Net income of $10M outside operations: $13M of interest and other income, less $2M of interest expense (figures as reported, before whole-million rounding).
oneTimers: A $7M gain on selling a business reduced operating expenses. On a non-GAAP basis — stripping out stock compensation, amortization and similar items — net income was $461M ($4.57 per share) versus GAAP net income of $360M ($3.54).

takeaways.title: AI demand is the whole story
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 137% year over year and 25% in just one quarter, with growth in every business. Gross margin jumped to 51.0% from 34.0% a year ago as richer products filled the mix.

takeaways.title: A second giant photonics win
takeaways.text: Lumentum secured its second major NPO/CPO win (near-package and co-packaged optics — putting photonics right next to the AI chip), backed by purchase commitments exceeding $5B, and expects optical switching to become a multi-billion-dollar annual revenue stream.

takeaways.title: Guidance steps up again
takeaways.text: Second-quarter guidance is revenue of $1.575–1.625B — about $350M more in one quarter — with non-GAAP operating margin of 45–46% and non-GAAP EPS of $5.90–6.20, versus a 42.3% margin this quarter.

footerNote: Lumentum reports in tenths of a million; this page rounds to whole millions (revenue $1,262M vs the reported $1,262.6M) so the flow balances exactly. Fiscal Q1 2027 ended September 26, 2026.
